sentence_stem: Although the article claimed that the new policy would reduce costs,
correct_completion: the report found no evidence to support this claim.
full_sentence: Although the article claimed that the new policy would reduce costs, the report found no evidence to support this claim.
acceptable_variants: the report still questioned its conclusions.
the authors remained doubtful about its savings.

options.text: so the report accepted the claim without question.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, but 'although' needs a contrast, so this option does not match the connector.

options.text: the report found no evidence to support this claim.
the policy was discussed at a meeting in March.
options.why_wrong: This gives background information, but it does not contrast with the claim made in the first part of the sentence.

options.text: the report was written by three researchers from the same university.
options.why_wrong: This adds a detail about authorship, but it does not complete the contrast set up by 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the sentence needs a clause that shows contrast with the claim in the first part. The correct option reverses the claim, while the wrong options either show a result with 'so' or add background details. Spanish speakers may be tempted to use a result connector here by habit, so check the logic of the contrast before choosing.
translation: Aunque el artículo afirmaba que la nueva política reduciría los costos, el informe no encontró pruebas que respaldaran esta afirmación.
